description: Get design principles relevant to a UI context. Returns usability heuristics, laws of UX, Gestalt principles, accessibility requirements, typography rules, and color theory — matched to what you're designing.

category.description: Filter to category: accessibility, brand, color-systems, color-theory, component-architecture, d4d, gestalt, laws-of-ux, mobile-ux, nielsen-heuristics, research, responsive-layout, service-design, spacing-systems, typography, ux-writing

context.description: What you're designing (e.g. 'signup form', 'pricing page', 'mobile nav', 'dark dashboard')

format.description: Output format: full (all details), checklist (implications + violations), brief (just summary). Default: full

platform.description: Platform context. 'ios' returns Apple HIG principles (Dynamic Type, 44pt targets, SF Symbols, safe areas, dark-mode, haptics, App Review privacy); 'react-native' returns RN principles (44/48pt+hitSlop, accessibilityLabel/Role, font scaling, SafeAreaView, dark mode, iOS+Android parity, secrets). Both replace the web/CSS-oriented set. Default: web.

name: get_principles
